title: Welcome to Nexus
lead: A desktop in your browser. Everything stays on this device and works offline.

windows.title: Windows
windows.body: Drag a window to a screen edge or corner to snap it. Hover the maximize button for layouts.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.body: Spread your windows over several desktops and switch with the dots in the top bar.

search.title: Search everything
search.body: The command palette finds apps, commands, settings and files.

personalize.title: Make it yours
personalize.body: Choose a theme, an accent color and a live wallpaper.
